title: Millions in cash found hidden behind walls in anti-mafia raid near Naples
content: Italian Carabinieri seized €3.2 million in cash hidden behind walls and in drawers during an anti-mafia operation near Naples.
snippet: Italian Carabinieri seized €3.2 million in cash hidden behind walls and in drawers during an anti-mafia operation near Naples.

title: Russian military helicopter violates Polish airspace, fighter jets scrambled
content: The Mi-8 helicopter entered Braniewo, close to the Kaliningrad exclave. It remained in Polish airspace for about 42 seconds.

title: One Single Planet: French photographer Yann Arthus-Bertrand on his 'Vivre Ensemble' portraits
content: Photographer Yann Arthus-Bertrand spoke to Euronews about his Vivre Ensemble portrait project, celebrating the people, diversity and connections that shape contemporary France.

title: EU Commission poised to formally back Albania's 2027 accession deadline
content: The Commission is set to formally back Albania's 2027 accession deadline in a new roadmap, which is also due to include a list of key deliverables Tirana will have to prioritise to complete the process by the end of next year.

title: Trump’s Russia tariffs could threaten to deepen Europe’s LNG squeeze
content: The European Commission has said it will work with Washington to make sure that as little disruption as possible will come from the latest tariffs against Russian energy announced by Donald Trump.

title: 'Cherry-picking sanctions' risks 'normalising' Russia, Latvian PM says amid Usmanov row

title: Kremlin dismisses warnings from France’s Le Pen and Bardella, saying Russia poses 'no threat'
content: Kremlin spokesperson Dmitry Peskov said Monday that Russia posed “no threat” to France or any other European country, responding to a statement criticising Moscow issued by Marine Le Pen and Jordan Bardella on Saturday.
